theme.pt: Dia 2 (12/11): Desembaraçando as Luzes de Natal com o Papai Vlad
theme.en: Day 2 (12/11): Untangling Christmas Lights with Dad Vlad

titleOptions: O Desafio das Luzes com Papai Vlad
pt.selectedTitle: 🎄 Desembaraçando as Luzes com Papai Vlad | Especial de Natal #2 #Shorts
pt.description: O segundo dia de preparativos é um desafio brilhante! Papai Vlad e a família tentam desembaraçar os fios para iluminar a casa azul.

en.selectedTitle: 🎄 Untangling Lights with Dad Vlad | Christmas Special #2 #Shorts
en.description: The second day of preparations is a glowing challenge! Dad Vlad and the family try to untangle the wires to light up the blue house.

text.pt: O segundo dia chegou e agora a família precisa enfrentar o grande desafio das luzes.
text.en: The second day has arrived and now the family must face the great light challenge.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic Pixar 3D style. Cream light golden-white Pomeranian dog wearing thin round gold-rimmed glasses, a blue-and-white vertical striped button-down shirt, and a dark navy blue bow tie. He is sitting on a rug holding a huge ball of tangled colorful Christmas lights. Cozy Christmas living room background, 9:16 vertical.

text.pt: Muito bem família, vamos transformar essa montanha de fios em um milagre de Natal brilhante.
text.en: Alright family, let's turn this mountain of wires into a shining Christmas miracle together today.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic Pixar 3D style. Black Pomeranian dog wearing round gold-rimmed glasses, a white pearl necklace, and a colorful floral print dress. She is gently holding a strand of lights next to Vlad. Warm golden Christmas lights in the background, 9:16 vertical.

text.pt: Cuidado para não puxar com muita força, querido, ou podemos acabar quebrando as lâmpadas pequenas.
text.en: Be careful not to pull too hard, dear, or we might break the tiny bulbs.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic Pixar 3D style. Cream light orange Pomeranian dog wearing rainbow multicolored frame glasses and a blue button-down shirt. He is pointing at a knot in the wires with his paw. Christmas tree with ornaments in background, 9:16 vertical.

text.pt: Eu acho que encontrei a ponta do fio verde bem no meio desse nó enorme.
text.en: I think I found the end of the green wire buried deep inside this knot.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic Pixar 3D style. Black Pomeranian dog wearing round gold-rimmed glasses, a white pearl necklace, and a pink ruffled blouse. She is holding one end of the lights carefully. Festive atmosphere, 9:16 vertical.

text.pt: Não se preocupe Theo, eu vou segurar o outro lado para não embaraçar tudo novamente.
text.en: Don't worry Theo, I will hold the other side so it doesn't get tangled again.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic Pixar 3D style. Cream light golden Pomeranian dog with no glasses, wearing a white button-down shirt and a dark bow tie. He is looking at the colorful bulbs with wide eyes. Twinkling lights background, 9:16 vertical.

text.pt: Vejam só quantas cores estão aparecendo conforme nós tiramos os fios de dentro da caixa.
text.en: Look how many colors are appearing as we pull the wires out of the box.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic Pixar 3D style. Close up of Vlad the Cream Pomeranian with his glasses and blue striped shirt, smiling warmly at his family. He looks proud and happy. Cinematic lighting, 9:16 vertical.

text.pt: Vocês estão fazendo um trabalho maravilhoso, já estamos quase prontos para iluminar toda a casa.
text.en: You guys are doing a great job, we are almost ready to light the house.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic Pixar 3D style. Raven the black Pomeranian smiling, her pearl necklace shining. She is surrounded by her family and Christmas decorations. Soft focus background, 9:16 vertical.

text.pt: Essa é a minha parte favorita do ano, apenas passar esse tempo tão precioso juntos.
text.en: This is my favorite part of the year, just spending this precious time with you.

text.pt: Feliz Natal pessoal, nossa casa será a mais brilhante e bonita de toda a vizinhança hoje!
text.en: Merry Christmas everyone, our house will be the brightest and most beautiful in the neighborhood!

en: A new holiday story every day!
